captures.what_is_new: Web Summit's 2026 speakers page says 800 speakers ('From AI to robotics, from China to Silicon Valley, and beyond'). The first page of the lineup, as read, leads with Chinese technology and robotics companies (AgiBot, Manus AI, Unitree, ModelBest, Xiaomi, Pony.ai, MiniMax, Tencent, Rokid, Galbot, Xpeng), alongside Replit, You.com and Cloudflare. One listed speaker is a robot: Galbot's G1.

story_candidates.title: A robot among 800 speakers: Web Summit 2026 turns to robotics
story_candidates.angle: What participants will see on stage: 800 speakers, a lineup whose first page leads with robotics and AI companies from China beside Silicon Valley names, and a robot, Galbot's G1, listed as a speaker. Técnico's Unitree robots in Pavilion 2 (S8, S10) show the same theme on the floor.
story_candidates.note: Name companies, not people: the capture names no individual speaker. Say 'the first page of the lineup', as the capture does.
